meta.title: Agnes image generator
meta.description: The sidebar Image entry opens two pages. Create: switch between text-to-image and image-to-image (upload or drag reference images, or send them from the gallery), write a prompt (with one-click AI polish) and pick source/model/ratio on the left, see the result on the right. Gallery: history grouped by date, with multi-select bulk delete. Settings can hold several API sources — each source's key is stored encrypted, never in plain text.
